crossRefs.note: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting…
“Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house…
on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the…
for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy, with his wife…
and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.
He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s…
that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the…
Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has…
Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning…
If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a…
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

people.name: Aquila
people.line: Jewish Christian tentmaker, co-worker with Paul

people.name: Priscilla
people.line: Early Christian teacher; wife of Aquila

translations.web: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
translations.bsb: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
translations.kjv: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
translations.asv: and he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more accurately.
